note: kascov's own KCC-20 vectors, in the shape of the official standard_transfer cases (kcc-0020/vectors/conformance.json at 1ed87ae, Final, the file unchanged since 1516a6c) and read against its common block. They cover a rule the official set does not: section 2 requires every input and continuation output of a standard transfer to share one extension_commitment (#16), and a reader can pass all six official standard_transfer cases while still accepting two classes side by side, each preserved. delegate_extension_commitments_hex is the one field the official format does not have: the delegate inputs' commitments, one per entry of delegate_amounts. Written for the spec authors to adopt or correct.

cases.reason: inputs and successors carry two extension_commitments, each preserved; a standard transfer keeps one
